beliefs: f shifts every UTF-16 code unit by +5, treating each code unit independently (astral chars shift as two surrogates) [E1-E10]
f appends a trailing 'W' to every output [E1, E7]
If the +5 shift on any code unit produces a lone surrogate or invalid surrogate pair, f raises ValueError and the whole call errors out, returning 'ERROR: ValueError' for that input [E10, E11]
When a shifted high surrogate stays a valid high surrogate and its shifted low surrogate stays a valid low surrogate, the pair remains valid and no error occurs [E10, E11]
notes: Added ValueError detection: after shifting each UTF-16 code unit by +5, check if the resulting sequence contains lone surrogates or invalid surrogate pairs; if so, output 'ERROR: ValueError' instead of the shifted string. Valid shifted pairs (like \udbff\udc05) pass through fine.
